Procedural preview

This is EDAmbilight's local animation playground, included with its MIT credit. It runs separately from the native lighting settings.

Open the animation and music controls

To use it as lighting input, maximize or fullscreen this window on the LG. The native capture policy will select it like any other LG app. Restore it to return to wallpaper lighting.

Return to the Office Ambilight application for your device map, capture controls and actual LED output preview. Close this browser tab when finished.
